ruleDefinitions.name: Winrar Compressing Dump Files
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of WinRAR in order to compress a file with a ".dmp"/".dump" extension, which could be a step in a process of dump file exfiltration.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\rar\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winrar\\\.exe$")) OR process_description = "Command\ line\ RAR") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dump.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.hdmp.*")))
